# CRP 
```{r}
CRP_data <- read.csv("Data/CRP Data/Analysis Data/CRP_Data_ED2WKM6_54_3-23-2026.csv")

crp_df <- CRP_data %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(
    RRS_df_median_2wk %>%
      mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
      dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group),
    by = "PID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
    Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6")
  )

crp_wide <- crp_df %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, CRP_log_adj) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = CRP_log_adj
  )

intervals <- tribble(
  ~Comparison,   ~time1, ~time2,
  "ED_vs_WK2",   "ED",   "WK2",
  "WK2_vs_M6",   "WK2",  "M6",
  "ED_vs_M6",    "ED",   "M6"
)

CRP_interval_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(intervals)),
  function(i) {
    comp  <- intervals$Comparison[i]
    time1 <- intervals$time1[i]
    time2 <- intervals$time2[i]

    crp_wide %>%
      dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group) %>%
      group_modify(~ run_paired_interval_test(.x, time1, time2)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        Marker = "CRP",
        Comparison = comp,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")))

CRP_results_EDWK2 <- CRP_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_WK2") %>%
  arrange(RRS_median_group, p.value)

CRP_results_WK2M6 <- CRP_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "WK2_vs_M6") %>%
  arrange(RRS_median_group, p.value)

CRP_results_EDM6 <- CRP_interval_results %>%
  filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_M6") %>%
  arrange(RRS_median_group, p.value)
```

## plot 
```{r}
crp_delta <- crp_wide %>%
  mutate(
    delta_ED_WK2 = WK2 - ED,
    delta_WK2_M6 = M6 - WK2,
    delta_ED_M6  = M6 - ED)

CRP_discordance_results <- bind_rows(
  run_delta_test(crp_delta, "delta_ED_WK2") %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_WK2"),
  run_delta_test(crp_delta, "delta_WK2_M6") %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "WK2_vs_M6"),
  run_delta_test(crp_delta, "delta_ED_M6") %>%
    mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_M6")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Marker = "CRP",
    abs_discordance = abs(diff),
    .before = 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_df_crp <- crp_df %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(RRS_median_group, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_crp = mean(CRP_log_adj, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(CRP_log_adj, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(CRP_log_adj))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_df_crp, aes(x = Timepoint, y = mean_crp, group = RRS_median_group, color = RRS_median_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_crp - se, ymax = mean_crp + se), width = 0.08) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "CRP (log-adjusted)",
    color = "RRS group"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High_RRS" = "cyan3", "Low_RRS" = "firebrick3")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
